'''Greyclimber''' was a particularly strong [[Kashyyyk bantha]] that lived in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] tracked down and killed Greyclimber to impress the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter [[Sordaan Xris]] and earn the prestigious [[Trophy for Excellence in Hunting in Etyyy]].
